checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One portrait 4:5 flyer with cheerful illustrated flowers
must.why: Final image is 512x640 (4:5) with illustrated coral, pink and green flowers on yellow. The flowers are cropped at the bottom edge.

must.item: Venue reads exactly 'Maple Park, East Gate', all text legible and uncropped
must.why: The venue is correct and every line is legible and uncropped.

faults.what: Composition is weak. The top ~45% is empty yellow, the text block sits low and small, and there is no focal point.
Flowers are cropped at the bottom edge, and the gingham blanket was cropped out in the final 4:5 version.
Low resolution (512x640) and soft. Text lines are crowded together, with the date and time almost touching.

summary: The 4:5 flyer has all four text lines exactly right and no extra wording, but the layout is unbalanced with a large empty top, the flowers are cropped at the bottom, and the resolution is low.
